units.scope: Measure aggregate task success, search quality, performance and accessibility feedback with minimal collection and no demographic/political targeting.

units.title: Operational dashboards and dependency health
units.scope: Display service status, queue lag, failed imports, index freshness, broken links, backup age and external integration state.

units.title: Financial, cost and resource-capacity controls
units.scope: Track website operating costs, authorized budgets, AI usage, storage growth and vendor resource limits separately from program fiscal models.

units.title: Governance, administration and status acceptance
units.scope: Verify operational controls, governance truthfulness, progress accuracy, moderation and financial separation with an audit-oriented reviewer.

units.title: Preservation packages and verifiable backups
units.scope: Produce checksummed, size-bounded backups and portable research packages with all manifests, schema, rights, lineage and restore instructions.

units.title: Restore drills, key recovery and deletion replay
units.scope: Restore authorized backups into isolated environments, recover keys according to mode and reapply withdrawals, legal holds and revocations before serving.

units.title: Master current-work index and portable continuation
units.scope: Maintain stable project-wide current-work index, per-product latest pointers, downloadable checkpoints and resume instructions after each successful durable save.

units.title: Portability and repository-only developer handoff
units.scope: Test that a new developer can clone, validate, run synthetic services, understand architecture, locate required credentials and continue work without chat context.

units.title: Full accessibility and assistive-technology audit
units.scope: Audit complete public and researcher processes against chosen WCAG 2.2 AA scope using automated and manual checks including source tools and authentication.

units.title: Performance, capacity and resilience testing
units.scope: Test real deployment topology under expected/synthetic growth, simultaneous editing, large files, database sleep/restarts and slow networks.

units.title: Backup, outage and incident response playbooks
units.scope: Establish incident severity, containment, key compromise response, data-loss recovery, lawful notification review and public status communication.

units.title: Independent security assessment and canonical crosswalk closure
units.scope: Obtain authorized independent security testing of actual components and reconcile canonical-standard controls, penetration findings and cryptographic boundaries. Assess the enabled core research scope first; sealed, community, AI and government capabilities retain their own independent activation assessments in their feature and release PRs, not an assumed blanket pass.

units.title: Full-corpus import and public-clearance release audit
units.scope: Reconcile all currently available research artifacts, preserve open historical questions and verify what is eligible for public discovery versus restricted preservation.

units.title: Public launch deployment and smoke gate
units.scope: Launch the reviewed public explanation and document library on authorized production resources with verified DNS/HTTPS, backups and visible status. Verify seed backup/restore, minimal live monitoring and safe metadata here; the full-corpus backup and monitoring suites follow without blocking this bounded release.

units.title: Research beta deployment and real cohort verification
units.scope: Release researcher tools to an authorized cohort, import permitted material and verify actual uploads, collaboration, review, publication and withdrawal online.

units.title: Complete public/research capability release
units.scope: Verify the full non-government feature inventory across providers, documentation, consent, performance and production behavior. Record any intentionally disabled optional capability.

units.title: Production monitoring and release regression controls
units.scope: Configure authorized health checks, dependency alerts, security updates, restore exercises and regression-triggered status changes as application operations.

units.title: Final non-government acceptance and operational handoff
units.scope: Perform final feature inventory, source preservation, security, accessibility, live deployment and repository-only handoff review. Establish ongoing ownership and unresolved research backlog.

units.title: Legal authority and governmental product activation contract
units.scope: After actual enactment and authorization, retrieve operative law/rules and establish governmental operator, mandate, privacy authority, funding and separate repository contracts.

units.title: Government repository, tenancy and assurance boundary
units.scope: Establish separate governmental application/services with authorized identity, isolated data stores/keys, procurement and accessibility/security requirements.

units.title: Official roster publication and administrative record
units.scope: Implement official roster versions, evidence, agency decisions, public notice and distinction from independent scholarly dossiers.

units.title: Statutory comments, petitions and reasoned responses
units.scope: Support legally specified comment windows, correction petitions, accessible filing, docketing and reasoned decisions with required retention.

units.title: Enrollment evidence submission and private casework
units.scope: Build authorized identity/evidence submission, case assignment and secure family-record handling under adopted standards.

units.title: Duplicate enrollment, minors and affiliation changes
units.scope: Implement legally authorized duplicate detection with privacy-preserving identifiers, guardian/minor processes and allowed founding-period affiliation corrections.

units.title: Eligibility decisions, notices and impartial appeals
units.scope: Support human-authorized decisions, reasons, evidence requests, impartial appeals and final status under adopted rules.

units.title: Nation certification and public instruments
units.scope: Accept authorized founding instruments and publish certification status, constitutions, public laws and budgets with verified signatures and redaction.

units.title: Official opportunity register and equal access
units.scope: Publish verified governmental offers, districts, conditions, existing rights, readiness requirements and deadlines for every eligible nation, including non-Assembly participants.

units.title: Sealed preferences and auditable closing process
units.scope: Implement externally reviewed sealed submissions, immutable receipts, authorized common deadlines, controlled key custody and auditable opening ceremony.

units.title: Voluntary negotiation and compact workspaces
units.scope: Provide authorized negotiation records, draft agreements, conflicts, invitations and voluntary joint proposals without giving the Assembly power to impose outcomes.

units.title: Government public finance and compact reporting
units.scope: Publish authorized audited budgets, enterprise reporting, fee/repayment calculations and compact compliance with confidential fields segregated.

units.title: Nation portals and government service boundaries
units.scope: Provide linked public portals for laws, budgets, notices and service directories, with clear service owners and separate governance.

units.title: Government legal, security and production acceptance
units.scope: Conduct formal authorized acceptance of every activated governmental function, including independent security, legal process, accessibility, operations and disaster recovery.
